intro: Effortlessly blending style and comfort, this 50x70 white and black striped cotton throw brings a refined touch to your space. Designed for modern living, it offers cosy warmth and practical functionality.

features.title: Light as air, cool to touch
features.text: Crafted from high-grade cotton, this throw delivers unmatched softness and durability for year-round cosiness.

features.title: Aesthetic Enhancements for Spaces
features.text: The sophisticated white and black stripe design complements contemporary decor, instantly uplifting any room’s ambiance.

features.title: Moves with you, keeps you cosy
features.text: Wrap yourself in warmth without the weight. This throw offers comfort for evenings while adding a practical layer of protection to your furniture.

care: Dry clean recommended or Gentle Hand wash with mild detergent and cold water.
name: 50x70 Cotton Throw
